scripts.dev:emulators: node scripts/emulator-env.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --ui --project demo-python-exercises "tsx scripts/dev-services.ts"
scripts.build: npm run validate:content && tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsx scripts/build-content.ts --emit-free && tsx scripts/generate-sitemap.ts
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-python-exercises "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,functions,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes && tsx scripts/build-content.ts --upload-premium
scripts.test:functions: node scripts/emulator-env.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-python-exercises "vitest run --config vitest.functions.config.ts"
